description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack

- When Frost is full, hold the Normal Attack Button to cast Frostfall.
- When Frost is full during the Fortune Rolling state, release the Normal Attack Button to cast Frostfall. If Youhu cannot cast Frostfall at the moment, perform Lucky Draw once instead.
Youhu can obtain Frost in the following ways:
- When Frost is not full, hold Normal Attack Button to enter the Fortune Rolling state and restore Frost over time.
- When Basic Attacks hit a target.

Heavy Attack: Frostfall

Youhu dashes forward, dealing Glacio DMG, and performs Lucky Draw once.

Mid-air Attack

Perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

When Youhu possesses no Antique, quickly press Normal Attack Button right after a successful Dodge to thrust forward, dealing Glacio DMG, and perform Lucky Draw once.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack

- Saat Frost penuh, tahan tombol Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Frostfall.
- Saat Frost penuh dalam state Fortune Rolling, lepas tombol Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Frostfall. Jika Youhu tidak dapat melancarkan Frostfall saat itu, lakukan Lucky Draw sekali sebagai gantinya.
Youhu dapat memperoleh Frost dengan cara berikut:
- Saat Frost tidak penuh, tahan tombol Normal Attack untuk memasuki state Fortune Rolling dan memulihkan Frost seiring waktu.
- Saat Basic Attack mengenai target.

Heavy Attack: Frostfall

Youhu melesat ke depan, memberikan Glacio DMG, dan melakukan Lucky Draw sekali.

Mid-air Attack

Melakukan Plunging Attack dengan biaya STA, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

Saat Youhu tidak memiliki Antique, tekan tombol Normal Attack dengan cepat tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menusuk ke depan, memberikan Glacio DMG, dan melakukan Lucky Draw sekali.

description.en:
Youhu smashes her scroll down at the enemy, dealing Glacio DMG, restoring HP for all party members nearby, and performs Lucky Draw once.

Lucky Draw

Youhu obtains a random Antique after the Lucky Draw. With an Antique, her next Basic Attack will activate the corresponding Antique Appraisal.
Only one Antique can exist at a time, and the newly drawn Antique will replace the existing one.

Antique Appraisal

- Chime: Attack the enemy with a Chime, dealing Glacio DMG. Chime can effectively reduce the enemy's Vibration Strength.
- Ruyi: Batter the enemy with a Ruyi, dealing Glacio DMG. Ruyi has a higher DMG Multiplier.
- Ding: Ram into the enemy on a Ding, dealing Glacio DMG. Ding can effectively break the enemy's stance.
- Mask: Throw a Mask at enemies in front, dealing Glacio DMG. Mask can pull in enemies along its path.
description.id:
Youhu menghantamkan gulungannya ke musuh, memberikan Glacio DMG, memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar, dan melakukan Lucky Draw sekali.

Lucky Draw

Youhu memperoleh Antique acak setelah Lucky Draw. Dengan Antique, Basic Attack berikutnya akan mengaktifkan Antique Appraisal yang sesuai.
Hanya satu Antique yang dapat ada pada satu waktu, dan Antique yang baru diundi akan menggantikan yang sudah ada.

Antique Appraisal

- Chime: Menyerang musuh dengan Chime, memberikan Glacio DMG. Chime efektif mengurangi Vibration Strength musuh.
- Ruyi: Menghantam musuh dengan Ruyi, memberikan Glacio DMG. Ruyi memiliki pengali DMG lebih tinggi.
- Ding: Menabrak musuh dengan Ding, memberikan Glacio DMG. Ding efektif mematahkan kuda-kuda musuh.
- Mask: Melempar Mask ke musuh di depan, memberikan Glacio DMG. Mask dapat menarik musuh di sepanjang jalurnya.

description.en:
Youhu hurls her scroll at the enemy, causing a Glacio DMG blast in the area.
On the blast, four buttons will appear. Choose a button within the specified time to obtain the corresponding Antique. Otherwise, obtain one random Antique.
description.id:
Youhu melontarkan gulungannya ke musuh, menyebabkan ledakan Glacio DMG di area tersebut.
Saat ledakan, empat tombol akan muncul. Pilih satu tombol dalam waktu yang ditentukan untuk memperoleh Antique yang sesuai. Jika tidak, memperoleh satu Antique acak.

description.en: Restore HP for all nearby party members based on 30% of the healing provided by Resonance Skill Scroll Divination when Resonance Skill Antique Appraisal is cast.
description.id: Memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar berdasarkan 30% dari healing yang diberikan Resonance Skill Scroll Divination saat Resonance Skill Antique Appraisal dilancarkan.

description.en: Gain 15% Glacio DMG Bonus for 14s upon casting Intro Skill Scroll of Wonders.
description.id: Mendapat 15% Glacio DMG Bonus selama 14 dtk saat melancarkan Intro Skill Scroll of Wonders.

description.en: Toss out the scroll and perform Lucky Draw once.
description.id: Melempar gulungan dan melakukan Lucky Draw sekali.

description.en:
At four Auspices, hold the Normal Attack button to release Poetic Essence, dealing Glacio DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG, while restoring HP for all nearby party members.
Youhu can hold up to four Auspices.

Poetic Essence

Deal Glacio DMG to enemies within the range and additionally obtain one of the following effects based on the Auspice combination:
- Free Verse: Four different types Auspices. Additionally reduce the Vibration Strength of hit enemies.
- Antithesis: A pair of Auspices. Increase Poetic Essence's DMG by 70%.
- Double Pun: Two pairs of Auspices. Additionally restore HP for all nearby party members.
- Triplet: Three identical Auspices. Increase Poetic Essence's DMG by 175%.
- Perfect Rhyme: Four identical Auspices. Simultaneously activate the effects of Free Verse, Double Pun, and Triplet.
Casting Poetic Essence removes all Auspices.

Auspice

- Youhu gains an Auspice through Antique Appraisal. Use Basic Attack while holding an Antique to receive the corresponding Auspice.
- Youhu unlocks Antiques by casting Resonance Skill Scroll Divination, Intro Skill Scroll of Wonders, Heavy Attack Frostfall, Resonance Liberation Fortune's Favor, and Dodge Counter.
description.id:
Pada empat Auspice, tahan tombol Normal Attack untuk melepaskan Poetic Essence, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG, sekaligus memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar.
Youhu dapat menyimpan hingga empat Auspice.

Poetic Essence

Memberikan Glacio DMG kepada musuh dalam jangkauan dan juga mendapat salah satu efek berikut berdasarkan kombinasi Auspice:
- Free Verse: Empat jenis Auspice berbeda. Juga mengurangi Vibration Strength musuh yang terkena.
- Antithesis: Sepasang Auspice. Meningkatkan DMG Poetic Essence sebesar 70%.
- Double Pun: Dua pasang Auspice. Juga memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar.
- Triplet: Tiga Auspice identik. Meningkatkan DMG Poetic Essence sebesar 175%.
- Perfect Rhyme: Empat Auspice identik. Mengaktifkan efek Free Verse, Double Pun, dan Triplet secara bersamaan.
Melancarkan Poetic Essence menghapus seluruh Auspice.

Auspice

- Youhu mendapat Auspice melalui Antique Appraisal. Gunakan Basic Attack sambil memegang Antique untuk menerima Auspice yang sesuai.
- Youhu membuka Antique dengan melancarkan Resonance Skill Scroll Divination, Intro Skill Scroll of Wonders, Heavy Attack Frostfall, Resonance Liberation Fortune's Favor, dan Dodge Counter.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: The incoming Resonator has their Coordinated Attack DMG Amplified by 100% for 28s.
description.id: Coordinated Attack DMG Resonator yang masuk di-Amplify sebesar 100% selama 28 dtk.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Youhu has a 10% chance to gain immunity to damage and interruption after casting Lucky Draw. This effect lasts for 5s or until she is switched out.
description.id: Youhu memiliki peluang 10% untuk mendapat kekebalan terhadap damage dan interupsi setelah melancarkan Lucky Draw. Efek ini berlangsung selama 5 dtk atau hingga ia diganti keluar.

description.en: The DMG bonus of Antithesis, Triplet and Perfect Rhyme on Poetic Essence is doubled.
description.id: DMG bonus Antithesis, Triplet, dan Perfect Rhyme pada Poetic Essence digandakan.

description.en: Every time Resonance Skill Scroll Divination is cast, there is a 20% chance that the skill will not enter Cooldown.
description.id: Setiap kali Resonance Skill Scroll Divination dilancarkan, ada peluang 20% skill tidak masuk Cooldown.

description.en: When Intro Skill Scroll of Wonders is cast, Youhu's Crit. Rate is increased by 15% for 14s.
description.id: Saat Intro Skill Scroll of Wonders dilancarkan, Crit. Rate Youhu meningkat sebesar 15% selama 14 dtk.

description.en: When casting Resonance Skill Antique Appraisal, gain 1 stack of Sky Blue, stackable up to 4 times, lasting for 7s. Each stack increases Youhu's Crit. DMG by 15%.
description.id: Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Antique Appraisal, mendapat 1 stack Sky Blue, bertumpuk hingga 4 kali, berlangsung selama 7 dtk. Setiap stack meningkatkan Crit. DMG Youhu sebesar 15%.
